text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday, during a time when I was 
running many races alongside Haru Urara to 
help her gain experience—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Ura-ura~♪ Ehehe, that walk was so much 
fun!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I got to eat tons of snacks, so starting 
tomorrow, I'll do my best again!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: My, oh my, what an energetic young lady.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's right, being full of energy is my 
best quality!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so... ...Oh my, you're an 
Umamusume, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: So, do you happen to run in races as well?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I run a whole lot! My name is Haru 
Urara!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara... Well, aren't you something. 
Oh my, you really are just as I heard.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. You know, I go to the 
shopping district over there quite often.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone over there was all fired up, 
saying they're gonna form a 'Haru Urara 
Fan Club.'"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: A fan c-club...? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that it was an organization 
that supports a person's activities 
through funding and other means...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~... Yeah, I don't get it at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That just means everyone will cheer for me 
even more, right?!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. Maybe I should join 
the fan club too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, come on in, come on in! Wait, can I 
come in too?
choice_data_list: Is Haru Urara cheering for Haru Urara?
Is Haru Urara cheering for Haru Urara?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's right! ...Wait, is it a little bit 
different?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, what a delightful girl. No wonder 
everyone loves her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with the lady who had 
spoken to us...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad. I've got so many 
people cheering for me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'm even gonna have a 'fan club,' so I've 
gotta work extra hard!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The more people there are cheering for 
her, the more strength Haru Urara will 
gain.
choice_data_list: Let's win over even more fans!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Urara, fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While continuing to gain experience by 
running in races, it was decided that we 
would grow her fanbase even further!"
